concerns.location: spec.md:SC-001 vs tasks.md:Dependencies and requirement coverage
concerns.text: SC-001 requires AUC-ROC to be measured against a baseline 'determined in implementation phase', but no task defines, records, or compares against that baseline. T104 only checks that AUC values exist; nothing produces the SC-001 comparison. Add a task (or extend T104) that fixes the baseline reference and records the exceed/not-exceed outcome.

SC-004 covers BOTH the 6-hour limit and 7 GB RAM ('without OOM or timeout errors'), but T102 measures only duration_seconds. No task measures or records peak memory usage. Extend T102 (or add a task) to record peak RSS and verify it stays under 7 GB.

The plan's workflow mandates 'Apply VIF filtering' during processing, but no preserved deliverable and no new task (T101–T108) implements or verifies VIF filtering — an orphan plan element with no matching task. Either add a task or note the plan element's disposition explicitly.

T107 writes results to 'specs/001-predicting-antibiotic-resistance-evolution/results.md' while the plan's declared feature directory is 'specs/001-predicting-antibiotic-resistance/'. The hedged '(or the active feature directory's results document)' leaves the deliverable path ambiguous; pick the plan's declared directory.
